data_quality.notes: Gold review: Wizz Air is a weight-tier and priority-access model. Basic fare includes only the 40 x 30 x 20 cm underseat bag, WIZZ Priority adds the overhead trolley, checked bags are sold as 10/20/26/32 kg products, and airport excess can add per-kg handling cost.

fees.conditions: Basic fare includes one underseat bag; overhead trolley access requires WIZZ Priority or an eligible bundle

data_quality.notes: Wizz’s free cabin allowance is the underseat bag. The overhead trolley bag is the paid/priority trigger and is the common surprise cost.

fees.conditions: WIZZ Priority adds a 10 kg trolley bag; price changes by route, season, availability, and purchase timing

data_quality.notes: WIZZ Priority is both a boarding/cabin-bag product and a capacity-sensitive add-on; airport purchase is materially more expensive than online purchase.

fees.conditions: 10 kg checked bag; maximum one per passenger and price changes by route, season, and timing

fees.conditions: 26 kg checked bag; price changes by route, season, purchase channel, and timing

data_quality.notes: Wizz sells 26 kg as a distinct checked-bag tier between the 20 kg and 32 kg products, so the right answer is selected-weight dependent.

fees.conditions: 32 kg checked bag; price changes by route, season, purchase channel, and timing

data_quality.notes: Basic fare includes no checked baggage. WIZZ Go/Plus bundles include checked baggage, while standalone bags are sold by selected weight tier; up to six pieces can be purchased.

data_quality.note: WIZZ Discount Club reduces eligible online baggage prices rather than waiving baggage entirely; the savings depend on the route, season, purchased bag, and whether companions are on the same booking.

fees.conditions: Excess above selected 10/20/26/32 kg tier triggers fees; no checked bag may exceed 32 kg
fees.applies_to: Checked bags above purchased weight allowance

data_quality.notes: The practical advice is to buy the correct weight tier before travel because the airline prices by tier, caps any one bag at 32 kg, and charges airport excess by kg.

fees.applies_to: Checked bags above published size limits

data_quality.notes: Wizz publishes maximum checked dimensions, but item type matters: sports and special baggage use a separate service rather than normal checked-bag pricing.

data_quality.note: Sports equipment is a paid special-baggage service and must be added during booking or at least 3 hours before departure; the published limit is 149 x 119 x 171 cm and 32 kg.
